name: Typewriter captions
description: Typed as it is said: each word's letters land across its spoken time in the mono face (or the text face), with a caret that blinks while the voice rests, straight on the footage or on dark boxes. Give a transcript with --words.

text.label: Text
text.description: what is said; leave empty to caption the transcript as it is. Wrap a word in *stars* for the accent
text.default: Typed out as you *say* it, letter by letter.

accents.label: Accent words
accents.description: words to put in the accent wherever they are said, comma separated

ground.label: Behind the words
ground.description: none: on the footage with a soft shadow · box: a dark box behind each line

parts.words: the caption words and everything drawn with them
